title: Lab - Application failure
description: Find the broken link in a two-tier app, repeatedly.
scenario: Find the broken link in a two-tier app, repeatedly. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Service
tasks.instructions: Users cannot reach the web app. Check the Service, its selector and the endpoints.
tasks.solution:
kubectl describe svc web-service -n alpha
kubectl get endpoints -n alpha

tasks.title: Task 2 - Environment
tasks.instructions: The web Pod cannot log in to the database. Compare its DB_User env with the mysql Pod.
tasks.solution: kubectl describe pod webapp-mysql -n beta | grep -A5 Environment

tasks.title: Task 3 - Port
tasks.instructions: The NodePort returns connection refused. Check the port numbers end to end.
tasks.solution: kubectl get svc -n gamma -o yaml | grep -E "port|targetPort|nodePort"
